niche_bends.angle_title: The Institutional Plumbing: 6 Ways to Protect from the Why US Bond Yields Are Surging Again — Do This ASAP! Shock Immediately
niche_bends.hook_contract: Every major finance channel told you yields are surging because of government debt. That is half the truth, and the half that leaves you unprotected. The other half is sitting on the balance sheet of the Bank of Japan.
niche_bends.consensus_trope: Alarmist / Doom ('Yields are surging - Do this ASAP!'). Recommends panic buying gold, cash, or generic advice.
niche_bends.structural_seam: Foreign central bank FX-hedged yield inversion. Japan holds $1.1T in Treasuries; when currency-hedging costs turn negative, domestic institutions repatriate capital, forcing yields higher regardless of Fed policy.
primary_evidence_needed: US Treasury TIC Foreign Portfolio Holdings (Record Document, highlighted Japan line)
10-Year Treasury Yield vs FX-Hedged JGB Yield (Coordinate Data Chart, blood red/green)
USD/JPY FX Intervention Tripwire Meter (Instrument Reading)
niche_bends.art_style_direction: Woodblock Vox Newsprint: Tokyo FX trading room split with US Treasury auction room. Translucent washi evidence docks with typewriter filings.
niche_bends.the_tonight_receipt: Open your brokerage account: check your bond fund's weighted average duration and foreign currency exposure. If your duration is over 7 years, calculate your drawdown if the 10-year prints 5.2%.

niche_bends.angle_title: The Accounting Tripwire: What Wall Street Buried in Footnote 12 About Why US Bond Yields Are Surging Again — Do This ASAP!
niche_bends.hook_contract: The market is pricing this move like a normal cyclical rate hike. But look at the corporate borrowing roll schedule. Between now and Q4, $1.8T in commercial debt resets from 2.1% to 6.8%.
niche_bends.consensus_trope: Macro generalization ('The Fed will pivot soon'). Ignores actual debt maturity walls and debt service ratios.
niche_bends.structural_seam: The refinancing maturity cliff: how fixed-rate corporate paper issued in 2020-2021 creates asymmetric credit default risk as debt rolls over.
primary_evidence_needed: Corporate Debt Maturity Schedule by Quarter (Coordinate Stacked Bar Chart, red accent)
SEC 10-Q Interest Expense Footnote (Typewriter Record Document with yellow callout)
High Yield Credit Spread Tripwire (Instrument Reading: OAS spread above 450 bps)
niche_bends.art_style_direction: Woodblock Vox Newsprint: Manhattan skyscraper boardroom at midnight with bank audit ledgers spread across the mahogany table.
niche_bends.the_tonight_receipt: Check your high-yield or corporate bond ETFs: look up their average coupon versus current market yield. That delta is the embedded write-down.

niche_bends.angle_title: The Asymmetric Hedge: How a Risk Desk Positions for Why US Bond Yields Are Surging Again — Do This ASAP!
niche_bends.hook_contract: Most investors react to yield spikes by freezing or panic-selling equities. On a bank risk desk, a yield spike is not a catastrophe; it is a known sequence of three dominos.
niche_bends.consensus_trope: Fear-based clickbait with no operational leverage ('The crash is here').
niche_bends.structural_seam: Three-stage liquidity contagion: duration risk -> private credit margin calls -> collateral liquidation. Explains the exact mechanical transmission sequence.
